description: WRITE (gated): create a brand (content profile) so create_draft and schedule_post have something to target. Every other write here needs a brand_id, so an agent had no way to set one up. Returns the brand_id and the Drive folder the publisher will read its media from (Viral-Cat/_Res/{name}/Vids). Publishes nothing and reaches no audience.

content_type.description: What the publisher should expect to find for this brand.

hashtags.description: Brand hashtags appended to captions unless skip_hashtags is set.

name.description: Brand name. Also names its Drive media folder, so keep it filesystem-friendly.

name: create_brand
